# Lady Patriots Tip-Off Club

> The Lady Patriots Tip-Off Club is an independent, community- and parent-led
> registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit that supports the Berkmar High School Girls
> Basketball program (varsity and JV) in Lilburn, Georgia. It funds uniforms,
> equipment, travel, tournament fees, training, team meals, and end-of-season
> recognition through donations and business sponsorships.

Key facts:
- Registered 501(c)(3) nonprofit; donations are tax-deductible to the extent
  allowed by law. Funds benefit the entire program, not individual athletes.
- Independent organization — not affiliated with Gwinnett County Public Schools.
- Head Coach: Reggie Hairston (Head Girls Basketball Coach, Berkmar High School).
- Contact: ladypatriotstipoffclub@gmail.com
- Checks payable to: Lady Patriots Tip-Off Club
- Motto: Proud · Driven · United

How to give:
- Online (one-time or monthly, via PayPal): https://ladypatriotstipoffclub.org/donate
- Business sponsorships from $250 to $2,500 per season:
  https://ladypatriotstipoffclub.org/sponsorship
  Levels: Championship $2,500 · All-Star $1,500 · MVP $1,000 ·
  Starting Five $500 · Sixth Man $250
- In-kind donations accepted: team meals, snacks and water, printing,
  transportation, equipment, gift cards, banners, professional services.

- [Sponsorship](https://ladypatriotstipoffclub.org/sponsorship): business sponsorship levels and benefits
- [Schedule](https://ladypatriotstipoffclub.org/schedule): 2026-27 varsity season, 26 games Nov-Feb; home games at Berkmar High School, Lilburn, GA
- [Coach](https://ladypatriotstipoffclub.org/coach): Coach Reggie Hairston
- [Coach's Letter](https://ladypatriotstipoffclub.org/letter): full letter from Coach Hairston on the program's story and needs
